4. **American Express** — Campus Full-Time Information Security Engineer 2027, London/Brighton/Burgess Hill · availability unverified (Oracle is JavaScript-only)
https://egug.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1/job/26013778

**Three could not be resolved to an employer link**

- **Deloitte** — Forensic Technology Summer Vacation Scheme 2027. Original route opens a Bright Network sign-up gate. Deadline **2026-10-19** (tomorrow).
- **Equilibrium Security** — Junior Penetration Tester. Employer page exists, no identifiable application control.
- **HP** — the link I gave you was a Bright Network category page, not a posting. Codex caught it: that "Information Security Engineer" entry belongs to American Express. No valid HP role was found, and I won't guess one.

**Two corrections worth noting**

- The Barclays link I gave earlier already was an employer domain, but it was a search.jobs.barclays.com shell. The real application route is the Workday requisition above, deadline 2026-11-01.
- The Amex link I gave earlier (26013761) is the undergraduate internship; the full-time 2027 role resolves to a different Oracle requisition, 26013778.

**Summary: 10 roles given → 4 original employer application links confirmed open, 1 employer link found but availability unverified, 3 unresolvable, 1 invalid association caught, 1 already-correct.**

The pattern: the resolver works when the employer has a real, reachable application page. It can't beat a membership gate (Deloitte/Bright Network) or a JavaScript-only shell (Amex Oracle).
